body.title: Body
body.default:
Dear {{applicantName}},

We hope this email finds you well. As part of our ongoing monitoring and compliance requirements, we kindly request your updated tax return for the year {{lastYear}}. This information is essential to ensure that your loan account remains up-to-date and compliant with regulatory guidelines.

To streamline the document submission process, we have provided a secure and convenient method for you to upload your tax return directly to our system. Please follow the instructions below:

Click on the following link to access our secure document upload portal:
{{portalLink}}

You will be redirected to a page where you can securely upload your Form 1040 (year {{lastYear}}). 

Please ensure that your tax return is in PDF or a compatible format.

Once you have uploaded the document, please review the provided confirmation message to ensure that your submission was successful.

It is important to note that failure to provide the requested tax return within the specified timeframe may result in a delay in processing your loan account and may impact your compliance with our loan agreement terms.

We understand the importance of safeguarding your personal and financial information. Rest assured that our document upload portal utilizes industry-standard encryption protocols to ensure the security and confidentiality of your data.

Should you encounter any technical difficulties or have any questions regarding the document upload process, please do not hesitate to contact our Customer Support team at [Contact Information]. We are here to assist you and address any concerns you may have.

We appreciate your prompt attention to this matter and your cooperation in providing the requested information. Thank you for being a valued customer, and we look forward to serving you further.

Best regards,
